verdict.rationale: Polar is API-first: official typed SDKs, including a Python SDK with sync and async clients, a Checkout Session API, an Events Ingestion API and versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs on the docs site all allow fully programmatic use without the dashboard. An isolated sandbox server suits automated test runs, and a `polar listen` CLI forwards webhooks locally. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation or examples, documented non-interactive auth (the MCP flow needs a browser OAuth sign-in and API tokens are not described), a general-purpose CLI beyond webhook forwarding, and independent hands-on corroboration; probes also found no OpenAPI spec at the root-level paths.
